source.method: Recursive installed akash --help; hidden flags checked against source; provider gateway flags checked against source.

exclusion_reasons.node-operator: Node server, local database, genesis, validator, or diagnostic utility: remains in akash (DESIGN 1.2/5.1).
exclusion_reasons.unfinished-jwt: Upstream auth jwt is unfinished: its not-before comparison rejects valid lifetimes, --nbf changes exp, and --scope reads access. Akt signs gateway JWTs internally; copying this utility requires a separate working token interface.
exclusion_reasons.unsupported-module: Empty transaction group for a module the Akash app does not expose for transactions; removed intentionally (DESIGN 5.1).
exclusion_reasons.empty-group: Empty upstream command group; no runnable transaction or flags to port.
exclusion_reasons.node-runtime: Reports the node-linked native wasmvm library; akt is a client and builds with nolink_libwasmvm.
exclusion_reasons.node-logging: Node logger controls are replaced by akt --verbose/--quiet; do not add flags that cannot affect akt logging.
exclusion_reasons.provider-offline: Gateway authentication verifies provider certificates against chain state, including with --provider-url. Offline gateway operation would bypass this trust boundary.
exclusion_reasons.provider-owner: Upstream registers a hidden --owner but derives the lease owner from --from. Akt uses its selected signing account; the upstream flag is not read.
exclusion_reasons.provider-sign-mode: Gateway JWT/mTLS authentication does not use transaction sign modes. The inherited upstream --sign-mode flag has no operation to configure.
exclusion_reasons.events-tail: Upstream lease-events registers --tail but never reads it, and the gateway event stream has no tail parameter. Not copied as a silently ignored flag.
